title: Two years after launch, Walmart’s Flipkart is closing in on India’s quick-commerce leaders
summary: Walmart-backed Flipkart's quick-commerce platform is processing 1.1 to 1.2 million orders per day, nearly triple its volume from November. The rapid growth demonstrates Flipkart's competitive positioning as it challenges established quick-commerce leaders in India's fast-growing delivery market.
content: Flipkart's quick-commerce venture is delivering 1.1 million to 1.2 million orders a day, nearly triple its November volume.

zh.title: 推出两年后，沃尔玛的Flipkart逼近印度快商领导者
zh.summary: 沃尔玛支持的Flipkart快商平台每天处理110万至120万订单，相比11月份增长近三倍。这一快速增长展示了Flipkart在印度快速增长的配送市场中的竞争地位，挑战着现有的快商领导者。
